text: Main courses Fundamental Law; Physical Education(PE); General Chemistry; Introduction to Computing; Introduction to Aerospace; Probability and Statistics; Circuit Theory Lab; Theoretical Mechanics; Programming Design Lab; Circuits and Electronics Lab Degree Award Students are required to complete the curriculum in 2.5, fulfill the designated degree courses, complete the master's thesis and defend of it in front of a panel of experts. Graduates will receive a graduation certificate along with the Master’s degree.
